lede: A big Sunday: sign-in with real names, Set Ups locked to Team Leads, a Schedule tab that helps with call-ins, and today's events front and center on Home. Every deploy was checked live.

tomorrow.title: Make the kitchen iPad a shared device
tomorrow.how: Sign in on it with the Manage PIN, reload, then Manage → Settings → Require sign-in → Make this a shared device. Same for any front iPad. Until then, logging waste on it asks for a PIN.

tomorrow.title: Check every Team Lead has the Team Lead role
tomorrow.how: Our Team → Profiles. Anyone listed as a Team Member gets asked for a lead's PIN on Set Ups.

tomorrow.title: Leads sign in once
tomorrow.how: Sign in, top right, with their clock-in PIN. Their phone stays signed in after that.

items.title: Only leads choose the Lead Captain
items.what: Team Members and Trainers can't pick who leads a shift.

items.title: PIN on file
items.what: Our Team shows who has a clock-in PIN; directors and the Admin Team can set one. Nobody can see a PIN.

items.title: Real names, not initials
items.what: The hub writes the signed-in person's name on what they log. The Require sign-in switch is in Manage, still off.

items.title: Sign in from any page
items.what: A Sign in sheet replaced the initials box, with Google one tap for @cfabuda.com.

items.title: Initials are gone
items.what: Anyone not signed in is asked to sign in before logging waste, a zone check or a note.

items.title: Set Ups safety, faster loads, 11 PM rule
items.what: A batch: saves that can't be lost, quicker page loads, and the Fri/Sat 11 PM close in the deploy rules.

items.title: Place trainees the schedule doesn't
items.what: The roster import lets a leader put a new hire on FOH or BOH.

items.title: Team Leads and up only
items.what: Only leads, directors and the Admin Team move people. Add Team Member picks from the team instead of a typed name.

items.title: The banner says what's open
items.what: Lead: choose only stands out when it matters; line icons.

items.title: Today's events at the top
items.what: Today on the calendar, with what's happening now. Tap one to see just that event.

items.title: Office and truck shifts count
items.what: Right Now and the Schedule tab agree on who's working.

items.title: See who's working
items.what: Directors, leads and the Admin Team get a link to the day's roster on the Schedule tab.

items.title: The Schedule tab
items.what: Each person's week while HotSchedules is down.

items.title: Roster in the Right Now look
items.what: Tap a name to see that person's week.

items.title: Not working
items.what: Who's off that day, fewest hours first, for a call-in.

items.title: Called · Coming in · Can't
items.what: So two leaders don't call the same person. Coming in adds them to Set Ups in one tap.

items.title: PIN on file folded under Profiles
items.what: Names added by hand in Set Ups no longer show up as new people.

items.title: Log a departure picks from the team
items.what: Picking a name fills in their role.

items.title: Boxes stay above the keyboard
items.what: Add Team Member, Sign in and the spot picker move up when an iPhone keyboard opens.

items.title: /day-summary
items.what: This recap, on demand.

bugs.title: The Google button sometimes didn't show
bugs.was: The page asked the server once who was signed in; if that request failed, the button never appeared.
bugs.fix: The button no longer waits on that answer, and the page asks again.

bugs.title: Right Now said you weren't working Monday
bugs.was: It only read FOH and BOH schedules; the shift was an office shift.
bugs.fix: It reads all four schedules, like the Schedule tab.

bugs.title: iPad Settings was missing the sign-in card
bugs.was: After a Manage PIN sign-in, Settings drew before Manage opened.
bugs.fix: It draws again once Manage is open.

bugs.title: A signed-out iPad wrote saved initials on waste
bugs.was: The hub fell back on initials typed on that iPad long ago.
bugs.fix: Initials are gone; it asks for a sign-in.

bugs.title: Phones held a change they couldn't save
bugs.was: After #248, phones that can't change Set Ups kept an empty call-in list as unsent. Caught by the live check.
bugs.fix: A new, empty setting no longer counts as a change.

waiting: Turn on Require sign-in once the PIN list is complete.
Fri/Sat: are the doors open until 11, or only the team?
Retire or keep the Schedule tab once HotSchedules works.
Phone numbers in the hub for call-ins, or not?
later: View-only Set Ups for the team
